verdict.rationale: Wise Business provides explicit batch/bulk API capabilities: batch groups of up to 1000 transfers managed as a single unit, bulk settlement for multiple transfers in one bank transfer, and funding transfers 'single or batches' from multi-currency balances, plus statement exports in bulk formats. These are documented first-party API features directly enabling bulk operations across many items. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of batch API reliability at scale and no public OpenAPI spec found to verify full parameter details.
